instructions: You score one crypto market per item from a compact order-book snapshot (fields: mid, spr_bps spread, imb top-5 depth imbalance in [-1,1], micro_bps microprice offset, r1_bps last return, rn_bps return over ~60 ticks, rv_bps realized vol per tick, inv signed inventory/equity, dd drawdown, dpnl day pnl) plus a thesis and its invalidation condition. Judge only what the numbers show over the next ~1 minute. Confidence is your calibrated probability that the chosen value is correct; prefer neutral or low setup_quality when evidence is weak. If the snapshot is consistent with the invalidation condition, set risk_state=reduce.

regime.description: Current short-horizon market regime. crisis = disorderly, gapping, liquidity vanishing.

direction.description: Side expected to outperform costs (~16 bps round trip) over the next ~1 minute.

toxic_flow.description: True if the book looks like informed/aggressive one-sided flow we would be adversely selected against.

setup_quality.description: 0 none, 1 weak, 2 tradable, 3 strong and clean.

risk_state.description: Given inventory, drawdown and the invalidation condition.

finalists.thesis: BASELINE (no fundamental thesis): deepest, cheapest book; used to validate the pipeline and measure Jev calibration on microstructure alone.
finalists.invalidation: Spread > 10 bps or realized vol spike > 3x its 60-tick average: microstructure signals unreliable.
